description: If x and y belong to the hierarchy stage at a, the union of x belongs to that stage, while their pair and the power set of x belong to the successor stage. If a is a nonzero limit, the pair and power set already belong to the stage at a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.stage_closure.{u} (a : Ordinal.{u}) (x y : ZFSet.{u})
  (hx : x ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann a) (hy : y ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann a) :
  x.sUnion ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann a ∧
    {x, y} ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann (a + 1) ∧
      x.powerset ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann (a + 1) ∧
        (Order.IsSuccLimit a → {x, y} ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann a ∧ x.powerset ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann a)
